config.source: ZAS validated local CSV; Cath Cad=1/Normal=0
config.target: AngioCAD feature-label ID intersection; no image data

mapping.Age: numeric years; adult18..110 plausibility; no clipping; source median fitted only in training
mapping.DM: direct same-name numeric0/1; convention retained without outcome-guided inversion
mapping.HTN: direct same-name numeric0/1; convention retained without outcome-guided inversion
mapping.Current Smoker: direct0/1; missing remains missing until source-training mode imputer

config.semantic_limit: Binary direction follows conventional provider same-name0/1 fields; accessible AngioCAD metadata lacks explicit 0=no/1=yes codebook. Clinical ascertainment/timing equivalence unverified; exploratory compatibility-constrained transport only.
config.outer: first3repeats x5folds original frozen ZAS assignments; reused/exploratory

arms.raw_full_source_fit: full-source training GridSearchCV-refit raw uncalibrated probability
arms.source_calibrated_ensemble: three source-trained search+sigmoid pairs; each search only calibration-training subset; average calibrated probabilities

config.source_calibration: ensemble=True; each full search nested within calibration-training folds; no target calibration
config.arm_comparison_limit: arms differ in training size, averaging and calibration; not a calibration-only causal comparison
config.endpoint_limits: not identical ZAS>=50; upper assignment is sensitivity bound not true >=50; nonobstructive not healthy
config.uncertainty: percentile record-bootstrap conditional on fixed source models and target case cohort; no model-refit/centre/patient-independence inference
config.excluded: all lab fields, Diagnosis, artery/angiographic fields, Gensini Score, LVEF/echo and medications
config.data_selection: ID match only; no missing-feature complete-case exclusion; target missing values use source fitted imputers
